north.evidence: Fairservis 1986, Fig. 2 on printed page 44 (PDF page 2; plan library entry allahdino-01): a half-arrowhead (solid wedge) with the letter 'N' beside its lower end, at the lower right of the plan. No meaning or survey date is stated. We take the straight right-hand side of the wedge as the shaft, from its lower end (tail) to the apex (tip); the 'N' sits near the tail.

scale.note: NOMINAL: the plan has no scale bar and no sourced dimension. 0.1 m per render pixel at 250 dpi is an arbitrary unit so that the tools run; every length_m and the 200 m neighbour check for this source are nominal. Bearings, theta, sigma, the system mean and its standard error do not depend on this scale.
